verdict.rationale: cubic supports per-repo configuration via cubic.yaml (custom agents, ignore patterns, PR rules) that could be replicated across repos, and 'custom agents' are framed as org-wide best-practice rules, but there is no documented central console for pushing defaults across hundreds of repos at once or managing exceptions centrally — each repo's cubic.yaml appears to be the source of truth individually. Missing for 10: evidence of an org-level admin dashboard/API to set defaults across many repos simultaneously, and a documented centralized exception-management workflow.
